name: Silt
author: Erin Carter
description: A riverbed current along the frame's floor: stretched FBM laminations form fine sediment streaks in the palette's cooler colours, dense at the bottom and thinning to a soft boundary, while sparse bright grains ride the current and catch the light. The upper two thirds stay a calm, faintly tinted near-black that breathes over ~20 seconds.

params.label: Current speed
params.effect: Horizontal drift rate of streaks and grains — a lazy seep at min, a brisk underflow at max.

params.label: Bed height
params.effect: Fraction of frame height the sediment band occupies, from a thin floor strip to over half the frame.

params.label: Grain
params.effect: CSS-pixel thickness of the sediment streaks and riding grains — silky fine lamination up to coarse strands.

params.label: Sparkle
params.effect: Density and brightness of the bright riding grains — zero is pure streaks, max scatters glints all along the bed.
